features.fullDescription: Early 19th century single storey cottage with attached steading range, enlarged and cottage raised to two storey in mid 19th century. Farmhouse now 2 storey, 3 bay, with projecting gabled porch at centre with corn-sheaf finial, gabled wall head dormers over outer bays, stugged ashlar, gabled, slated, rectangular end stacks with cavetto cornice. Inset stone to left of door has inscription "IDFW 1807". Single storey, single pitch roofed extension to west with big octagonal corner stack. Long single storey, pantiled, rubble range attached at east with two storey, double gabled, pantiled block at East End. 2-storey, piended, pantiled blocks project to South at East and west ends. Second single storey pantiled range, parallel to 1st joins eastern projecting block at west side.

features.fullDescription: 1773 with 19th century additions and alterations. Originally long low pantiled range running north south and facing west, with later broad, taller return wing to East at south, rubble with ashlar margins. Northern part; two storey, ground floor openings altered, 3 small loft openings at 1st. At centre: 3 bay cottage with dated lintel over centre door, next 3 bays to South raised to two storeys c 1900 with gabled wallhead dormers to West, catslides to East, slated roof, rectangular corniced end stacks. Lower range continues to South with large modern cart opening before returning to East, piended at West, gabled to East. Cartshed block with loft over added c 1900 at North end returning to East, rubble with droved ashlar margins, slated piended roof. Facing East opposite main range two single storey, pantiled cartsheds, that to the North piended, that to the South larger and gabled.
